purpose: Governed, machine-readable proposal boundary allowing an AI agent to recognize potentially valuable intelligence and request Smart Note capture without creating a second memory or authority system.
architectural_principle: AI recognition may initiate a proposal; existing NayaPOWER governance decides authority, privacy, truth state, persistence, projection, and consequential use.

canonical_storage.rule: A proposal never creates an alternate Smart Note directory or competing memory store.

relationship_to_existing_system.smart_note: The canonical durable intelligence artifact after an approved capture.
relationship_to_existing_system.smart_ledger: Existing evidence/accountability layer; proposal creation does not create a second ledger.

states.VALUE_RECOGNIZED: AI has identified a potentially durable or reusable insight but has not established truth or authority.
states.PROPOSAL_VALIDATED: The proposal satisfies this contract's structural and provenance requirements.
states.GOVERNANCE_EVALUATED: Existing governance has evaluated authority, privacy, scope, risk, and evidence status.
states.CAPTURE_AUTHORIZED: The existing authorized Smart Note path permits creation of the canonical artifact.
states.CANONICAL_SMART_NOTE_CREATED: A canonical Smart Note exists at the resolver-produced repository path.
states.PIS_INGESTED: The existing Primary Intelligence System accepted the canonical Smart Note event.
states.INDEXED: Existing indexing/projection can locate the same intelligence object.
states.RETRIEVABLE: The same object can be retrieved in a fresh context.
states.APPLIED: Retrieved intelligence materially influenced a later governed action.
states.VERIFIED: The application produced evidence satisfying its stated verification criterion.
states.LEARNING_UPDATED: Verified learning was retained through the existing learning path.

privacy.sharing_authority_ref: required for any state above PRIVATE

derived_fields.canonical_path: must be computed by the existing Smart Note resolver; agent must not supply an alternate physical directory
derived_fields.smart_note_id: assigned only when canonical capture occurs
derived_fields.primary_event_id: assigned by the existing Primary Intelligence System
derived_fields.verification_receipt_ref: assigned only by the existing verification/evidence path

hard_rules: A proposal is not a Smart Note.
Capture authorization does not establish truth.
A private source cannot become public merely because an AI recognized value.
The agent may explain why something appears valuable but may not fabricate evidence.
The proposal must preserve source provenance and uncertainty.
The existing governance authority remains the sole authority for consequential authorization.
The existing Smart Note resolver remains the sole canonical storage path.
The existing Primary Intelligence System remains the event/index/projection layer.
The existing Smart Ledger remains the accountability/evidence layer.
Duplicate proposals may be deduplicated, but deduplication must never silently merge conflicting provenance.
Rejected proposals remain distinguishable from accepted Smart Notes.
No proposal may directly authorize execution, publication, disclosure, policy change, or external action.
No proposal may create a second memory database, Smart Note directory, governance kernel, or evidence authority.

governance_decision.rule: BLOCKED or UNKNOWN is never promoted to ACCEPT_CAPTURE without new evidence or authority.

required_sequence: emit/use existing Smart Note event identity

minimum_proof: proposal_id remains linked to the resulting Smart Note
canonical repository path matches the resolver
no duplicate canonical Smart Note is created for the same accepted proposal
stronger_learning_proof: retrieved intelligence influences a later governed action
verification receipt links outcome to the application
any claimed improvement satisfies the existing compounding measurement contract

recognition.why_valuable: The same architectural lesson can prevent repeated Smart Note path divergence across future agents.
recognition.proposed_future_use: Use the canonical resolver contract whenever any Naya creates a Smart Note.

candidate.title: Canonical Smart Note resolution prevents agent divergence
candidate.lesson: One resolver and one authoritative artifact prevent multiple Nayas from creating incompatible Smart Note locations.
candidate.content: The canonical Smart Note path must be resolved mechanically rather than remembered conversationally.

non_goals: Creating a second Smart Note persistence system.
implementation_order: 1. Validate this proposal contract at the existing Smart Note receiver boundary.
2. Bind proposal_id to the existing canonical Smart Note create path.
3. Preserve provenance/privacy/evidence status through PIS ingestion.
5. Prove fresh-context retrieval of the resulting canonical Smart Note.
6. Only then evaluate automatic AI-initiated proposal generation.
